# SAI Deal Radar

> Continuously-refreshed radar of real, source-cited opportunities: AI/ML grants, business-succession listings, property/relocation schemes and venture vehicles — 122 deals across 45 countries in 20 regions. Every entry links to its official source. ARM-classified and impact-ranked (see JSON for the full `arm_priority` and `arm_rationale` per deal).

## Primary data (machine-readable)

- [Full dataset (JSON)](https://sai-agency-deals-radar.netlify.app/deals.json): every deal with impact score, ARM stage, next action, evolved arm_priority and rationale.
- [Deal feed (RSS 2.0)](https://sai-agency-deals-radar.netlify.app/deals.xml): subscribe to new deals.
- [Sitemap](https://sai-agency-deals-radar.netlify.app/sitemap.xml): every deal page.
- [Agent manifest](https://sai-agency-deals-radar.netlify.app/.well-known/agents.json): programmatic entry point for agent discovery.

## Human pages

- [Deal Radar (home)](https://sai-agency-deals-radar.netlify.app/deals): filterable radar.
- [By country](https://sai-agency-deals-radar.netlify.app/countries): per-country landing pages.
- [Demo pathways](https://sai-agency-deals-radar.netlify.app/demo): succession / repopulation / venture.
- [Match](https://sai-agency-deals-radar.netlify.app/match): matchmaker from a pasted business plan.

## Optional

- [Per-country pages](https://sai-agency-deals-radar.netlify.app/countries) — each country page is a focused landing surface; use these for geographic queries.
- [Full deal detail pages](https://sai-agency-deals-radar.netlify.app/deals/<id>) — one page per deal, with JSON-LD and a direct "pursue" form.
